palette: lacquer black hall + twin warm paper screens tinted vermilion and indigo + gilded dispute axis + antique gold accents + jade concession marks
typography: heavy kai plaque headings on paper screens, mirrored twin-camp labels, cinnabar and indigo verdict stamps, thin gold axis rules, vermilion brush underlines reserved for the discriminator
composition: a central gilded axis divides facing screen panels on a lacquer hall floor; paired school lanes mirror across the axis; containment nests a law frame inside the moral-order frame on the right wing
surface: deep lacquered ground with faint vertical grain bands, tall paper screen panels with dark lacquer feet, hairline gold frames, flat mineral-pigment fields, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: twin panels slide in from both wings and lock against the central axis, paired elements land symmetrically from the axis outward, verdict stamps seal with a press, the law token descends into the moral-order frame
transition: axis-anchored parting slide where the previous screen pair opens like doors along the gilded axis
